Paycheck state tax = EDD 2026 withholding (Method B) and SDI, read from ../withholding-ca.json at load time so the paycheck, overtime and California overtime calculators share one table. FTB 2025 rate schedules (ftb.ca.gov/forms/2025/2025-540-tax-rate-schedules.pdf): 1% to 12.3% on the same bracket edges EDD uses for 2026, plus the 1% Mental Health Services Tax over $1 million. Verified 2026-10-13.
name: California
notes: California's income tax runs from 1% to 12.3%, plus another 1% on income over $1 million for mental health services. That top 13.3% is the highest state rate in the country, but a typical full-time salary lands in the 4% to 9.3% brackets.

This calculator shows what your employer withholds, using the EDD's 2026 withholding tables (one allowance, or two if you're married filing jointly). Those tables run a little above the actual tax rates — 1.1% to 14.63% — so many Californians get a small state refund when they file.
California also takes 1.3% of every dollar you earn for State Disability Insurance (SDI) in 2026. There's no wage cap anymore, so it applies to all of your pay. It's included in the result above.
One thing California does differently: it taxes HSA contributions. If your pre-tax deductions include an HSA, your real California withholding will be a little higher than shown.

Want a California tax calculator for one paycheck? Enter your gross pay, pick how often you're paid, and add any 401(k) or other pre-tax deductions. You'll see federal tax, California tax, SDI and FICA broken out, plus what lands in your account. Working extra hours? Our California overtime calculator covers that.
notIncluded: California withholding assumes one allowance (two if married filing jointly).
